title: Meet Veterans in J.P. Morgan Private Bank | JPMorgan Chase
description: We recognize and honor our military members, veterans and their families, today and every day. Watch to meet veterans from our Charlotte office, and learn more about our initiatives to support veteran employment. SUBSCRIBE: http://jpm.com/x/i/NFPWfK0  About J.P. Morgan: J.P. asr.full_text: PAGE FORD'S CLIENT ADVISOR My name is Paige Ford. I am a client advisor here in Charlotte within the private bank. I serve for 5 years on active duty as a combat and civil engineer in the Army. My name is Steven Price. I was a captain in the United States Marine Corps and I'm currently a client advisor with the private bank here in Charlotte. On a daily basis I find similarities between my soldiers in the army and my colleagues here at JPMorgan's Private Bank. I am surrounded by morals and ethics and a team environment and a group of people that share one common mission. JPMorgan helps ease the transition for Veterans a number of ways. I work with some of the individuals in the Pathways Program to help mentor them and help them find the best route to success. The Veteran Jobs mission in particular has taken off. 547,000 Veterans have been hired since this initiative was launched in 2011. Today's event, which I'm extremity excited about, is a celebration of service for Veterans Day. About six months after joining the firm full time in New York City, my husband, who is a Green Beret at Fort Bragg, said I need you to come home. I need you here. It is likely that I will be going to Afghanistan and the reality is you don't know if they're coming home. I felt like I was betraying my boss. She didn't even blink an eye. She said, you're right, I'm going to make it happen. And within weeks, she had coordinated the logistics for me to move down to North Carolina and be the first employee that they hired for JP Morgan's private bank in the Charlotte office. And for that reason, I will always have a profound sense of loyalty to this firm."
